name: Hugging Face
freeTierNote: Free Hub account with CPU Basic and ZeroGPU.
priceBand: Free Hub account; PRO — check official pricing
bestFor: Finding, running, and shipping open models without pretending they are consumer apps
skipIf: You want a chat UI with a support phone number
keyFeatures: Canonical hub for open model weights and datasets
Model cards with license and eval disclosures
Hosted Spaces for quick model demos
limitations: Infrastructure hub, not a consumer chat app
Production inference requires separate compute billing
summary: The model hub. Not an assistant. If you cannot tell the difference, you are not the customer yet.
body: Hugging Face is infrastructure and community, not “an AI tool” in the ChatGPT sense. We include it because every serious builder ends up there for weights, Spaces, or datasets. Inference pricing is a separate bill. Hub checked 16 Sep 2026.
notes: Pair with Groq or other hosts for speed
